mapper.sql: SELECT delivery.id, delivery.mail_type, delivery.source_id, delivery.reply_id, delivery.recipient_email, NULLIF(delivery.recipient_masked, '') AS recipient_masked, CASE WHEN delivery.recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN recipient.deleted_at IS NULL THEN recipient.email ELSE NULL END ELSE original_message.email END AS current_recipient_email, delivery.recipient_user_id AS user_id, recipient.username AS user_username, CASE WHEN recipient.deleted_at IS NULL THEN recipient.nickname ELSE NULL END AS user_nickname, CASE WHEN recipient.id IS NOT NULL THEN recipient.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ELSE NULL END AS user_deleted, delivery.status, delivery.attempt_count, delivery.last_error_type, delivery.last_error_message, delivery.sent_at, delivery.last_attempt_at, delivery.created_at FROM blog_mail_delivery delivery LEFT JOIN blog_user recipient ON recipient.id = delivery.recipient_user_id LEFT JOIN blog_message_board original_message ON delivery.mail_type = 'MESSAGE_REPLY' AND original_message.id = delivery.source_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_mail_delivery WHERE id = #{deliveryId} FOR UPDATE
